chunk_text: Witness testimony collected by the ICTY confirmed that Ratko Mladić ordered the execution of prisoners held at the Kravica warehouse near Bratunac in July 1995.
The UN Security Council Resolution 827 established the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia to prosecute war crimes committed during the conflict in the Balkans.

chunk_text: Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces conducted a joint operation in West Darfur, targeting the Masalit community in El Geneina in April 2023.
According to the Human Rights Watch report, detainees at Manjača camp were subjected to forced labour, including clearing minefields without protective equipment.
Former camp commander Zdravko Tolimir was convicted by the ICTY in 2012 for genocide and crimes against humanity relating to the Srebrenica massacre.
